_comment: Per-die map: rolled value -> local mesh face normal (glTF Y-up) that, when aligned to world UP, shows that value. Generated/verified via tools/dice_facemap.py + scripts/_tmp_facecal.gd calibration renders. d6 verified sum-to-7. Dice without an entry fall back to a random landing orientation. To add d4/d10/d12/d20: run the facemap + calibration, read the digit per face, and fill in value->normal here.
